universities.summary: Bharathidasan University is a public state university established in 1982 in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu. Its university departments at Palkalaiperur and Khajamalai offer postgraduate, integrated and vocational degrees across humanities, social sciences, physical and life sciences, management and technology. These listings cover 47 verified regular degree routes; affiliated colleges and distance education have separate admissions.
universities.campusLifestyle: Palkalaiperur houses the central library, sports complex, bank, post office, canteen and health centre. Khajamalai hosts selected departments and entrepreneurship activities. Library services include INFLIBNET, DELNET, electronic resources and a 24-hour Garden Library; sports facilities include an indoor stadium, gymnasium, yoga centre and 400-metre athletics track.
universities.cityProfile: Bharathidasan University is based in Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu. Its Palkalaiperur main campus is on the Tiruchirappalli–Pudukkottai–Rameswaram highway; a second campus is at Khajamalai in the city. Department and accommodation allocation matter when planning the daily journey between university facilities.
universities.practicalExposure: The Financial Management MBA includes at least four weeks of institutional training after semester two and a final-semester project. Its Centre for Financial Markets works in association with NSE Academy Limited, with finance-firm case analysis and project reports built into the curriculum. Integrated M.Tech students share a first-year curriculum before their academic work is administered by the relevant specialist department. The university also operates a Placement and Training Cell that organises job fairs.
universities.hostelOverview: Hostels are located at Palkalaiperur and Khajamalai, including separate accommodation for men, women and research scholars. Eligibility is limited to students residing at least 40 kilometres from the university. Facilities include Wi-Fi, kitchens and dining rooms, water supply, reading rooms and recreation areas. Current room and mess charges need a hostel quotation before budgeting.
universities.dietarySupport: University hostels have kitchens and dining facilities, and the Palkalaiperur campus has a canteen. Discuss required meals and any dietary restrictions with the hostel before taking a place; current mess charges need a separate accommodation quotation.
universities.safetyOverview: An Anti-Ragging Cell addresses ragging, while the anti-sexual-harassment committee and Students Affairs Cell handle related complaints and grievances. The main campus includes a health centre. These are named campus services, rather than a guarantee about personal safety.
universities.studentSupport: The International Students Cell handles overseas admission categories and qualification assessment. The Centre for Differently Abled Persons supports disability-specific study routes, and the university runs student-affairs and grievance services. Students Traffic can help match qualifications, programme requirements and the appropriate application route.

faq.question: Is Bharathidasan University a public university?
faq.answer: Bharathidasan University is a Tamil Nadu state university established in 1982. The UGC consolidated register lists it at Palkalaiperur, Tiruchirappalli; its university departments are separate from the colleges affiliated to it.

faq.question: Which campus will I study at?
faq.answer: The university operates its main Palkalaiperur campus and the Khajamalai city campus. Palkalaiperur contains the central library, sports complex, health centre and administrative buildings; department and hostel allocation determine your daily campus.

faq.question: Are the programmes taught in English?
faq.answer: English is verified for the preserved Financial Management MBA and three six-year integrated MTech English options. Teaching language has not been verified for the newly added routes; confirm the exact programme with its department. A Tamil or English subject title alone does not establish teaching medium.

faq.question: Can I enter an integrated M.Tech after school?
faq.answer: The six-year integrated programmes admit after Plus Two or equivalent, with subjects specified separately for Biotechnology, Computer Science and Engineering, and Geological Technology and Geoinformatics. The university describes entrance-based selection for integrated programmes; this is a longer route than a two-year postgraduate M.Tech after a prior degree.

faq.question: What does the Financial Management MBA require?
faq.answer: For 2026-27, eligible qualifications include B.Com., B.B.A., Corporate Secretaryship, Bank Management and related Commerce degrees, with an Accountancy course and at least 50% under Part III. Selection gives equal weight to Part III marks and the entrance test. Valid scores in the tests named in the prospectus allow entrance-test exemption.

faq.question: How much is tuition for Indian students?
faq.answer: The preserved Financial Management MBA and integrated MTech routes publish INR 20,000 semester tuition, equivalent to INR 40,000 for two semesters. Newly added programmes show their separately verified semester tuition quotes where available. Laboratory, university, admission, examination and living charges require a separate itemised budget.

faq.question: Do foreign students pay the same amount?
faq.answer: Foreign-student tuition follows a separate USD policy, with different treatment for developed and other countries. Its outside-India qualification column also includes recognition charges. Obtain an individual international fee assessment rather than treating an Indian-student admission total as your foreign-national tuition.

faq.question: How do I apply to a university department?
faq.answer: Use the regular University Departments admissions portal and select the exact programme. The general MBA, Logistics and Supply Chain Management MBA, and International Business MBA use Tamil Nadu MBA/MCA counselling instead; Financial Management has its own department selection rules. Students Traffic can help identify the route for your qualification.

faq.question: When does the academic year begin?
faq.answer: The four preserved routes retain their previously verified usual July pattern. Newly added degrees do not have a verified first-entry month assigned. Most 2026–27 applications are marked closed; confirm the exact vacancy or next-cycle notification.

faq.question: Can international and NRI students apply?
faq.answer: The International Students Cell covers foreign passport holders, NRIs educated abroad and qualifying NRI-sponsored students. It describes postgraduate and integrated programmes and assesses overseas qualifications. Category-specific admission, fees and document requirements need confirmation for the intended programme.

faq.question: Is hostel accommodation available?
faq.answer: Hostels operate across Palkalaiperur and Khajamalai, with separate accommodation for men and women and dedicated research-scholar hostels. Hostel eligibility is limited to students living at least 40 kilometres away. Rooms have Wi-Fi, dining facilities and reading or recreation spaces; a current accommodation quotation is needed.

faq.question: Does the MBA include practical training?
faq.answer: The Financial Management MBA requires at least four weeks of institutional training after semester two and a final-semester project. The regulations describe work in finance firms and a Centre for Financial Markets associated with NSE Academy Limited. These are curriculum features and do not promise employment or a particular salary.

evidence.claimText: Palkalaiperur houses the central library, sports complex, bank, post office, canteen and health centre. Khajamalai hosts selected departments and entrepreneurship activities. evidence.claimText: Hostels are located at Palkalaiperur and Khajamalai, including separate accommodation for men, women and research scholars. evidence.claimText: The International Students Cell handles overseas admission categories and qualification assessment. evidence.claimText: An Anti-Ragging Cell addresses ragging, while the anti-sexual-harassment committee and Students Affairs Cell handle related complaints and grievances. The main campus includes a health centre. These are named campus services, rather than a guarantee about personal safety.

evidence.claimText: The Financial Management MBA includes at least four weeks of institutional training after semester two and a final-semester project.
